name: Consumer Terminal Checkout
author: Figarellihousedev

sections.description:
CT Checkout is a custom WooCommerce checkout plugin designed to work seamlessly with the CTC app. It enables a tailored checkout experience that integrates with the app’s unique flow and features.

To enable the custom CT Checkout option, your WooCommerce store must be using the Classic Checkout page layout. This layout provides the necessary structure to support the plugin’s customized behavior and integration points with the CTC platform.

Perfect for stores that need to streamline checkout for compatibility with CTC’s services, CT Checkout ensures a smoother experience for both merchants and customers.

This plugin initiates an API call to a secure remote server to process a transaction using encrypted card information submitted by the customer. The remote call is required in order to securely validate and process the payment using data stored in a protected and PCI-compliant environment. This ensures sensitive payment information is never handled or stored directly on the merchant’s WordPress site, enhancing overall security and reducing compliance scope.

Important Notice on External Dependencies

This plugin relies on a third-party service to complete payment transactions. Specifically, it sends encrypted payment token data and order details to a secure API endpoint provided by an external service.

  • The third-party API service is required for secure transaction processing.
  • No payments can be completed without communication with this external endpoint.
  • This is a necessary part of the payment flow to ensure PCI-compliant handling of sensitive information.

Service URL: https://www.consumerterminalcheckout.com/
Service Privacy Policy: https://www.consumerterminalcheckout.com/privacy-policy/

If you require a solution that functions entirely within your own infrastructure, this plugin may not be suitable, as external communication is essential to its purpose.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/consumer-terminal-checkout directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable CTC Payment.
  4. Configure your Merchant ID under CTC Settings in the admin dashboard menu.
  5. In the WordPress Page Editor, set your WooCommerce Checkout page to use the “Classic Checkout” layout to ensure compatibility with the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin PCI compliant?

This plugin does not store or handle card details directly. All sensitive information is securely transmitted to a remote PCI-compliant server for processing.

Why does this plugin make an external request?

To process secure payments, the plugin sends encrypted card token and order data to a verified, secure server endpoint. This ensures your store does not directly handle sensitive payment data.
